# D24 inline shoulder roll vs the belt roll (generated by `python -m rnd.roll_inline`)

python -m rnd.roll_inline dome drive                          # inline (the default drive)
    PIP_ROLL_DRIVE=belt python -m rnd.roll_inline <check>         # check ∈ dome, drive, assembly_seq, spacing, swept, dexterity, basket

The CAD and the twin read params.ROLL_DRIVE at import, so each drive is a separate run. Results go to
docs/rnd/roll_inline.json (one entry per drive and check) and docs/rnd/roll_inline.md; the baseline reports
(assembly_seq.md, swept.md, ...) are those of the default (inline) drive and are not touched here. Run one heavy check at a time.

| Check | belt (GIM6010-8 + 18T:80T) | inline (GIM8108-36) |
|---|---|---|
| Shoulder dome, fore-aft × height (mm), CAD | 148 × 211 (slim-study ESTIMATE 172 × 210) | 121 × 96 (slim-study ESTIMATE 128 × 120) |
| Dome reach outboard of the detach plane (mm) | 145 | 117 |
| ROLL_Y / yaw_drop (mm) | 83.0 / 113.4 | 69.0 / 99.3 |
| Roll / yaw stage mass, CAD (kg, actuator not included) | 0.68 / 0.56 | 0.29 / 0.55 |
| R14 assembly sequence, roll row | ✅ (7/7 shafts) | ✅ (7/7 shafts) |
| R15 spacing, roll/yaw module (under target / hard) | 3 / 0 ✅ | 2 / 0 ✅ |
| R15 swept: min gap roll / yaw (mm); pairs under target / hard | 0.7 / 2.0; 0 / 0 ✅ | 0.3 / 2.0; 0 / 0 ✅ |
| R16 dexterity: top-down / 45° / side / across | 34% / 70% / 65% / 52% ❌ | 36% / 68% / 66% / 60% ✅ |
| R2d basket: worst duty margin; roll peak margin | not run | 1.50; 51.6× ✅ |
| Shaft → link drive: worst capacity / joint peak (drive_capacity) | 1.55× ✅ | 1.03× ✅ |

Shaft → link torque paths (belt; Astra #2b finding 2; hand calculations, ESTIMATE inputs as listed):

| Joint | Path | Capacity | Demand | Ratio | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| roll (belt) | roll shaft ↔ clevis, 2 pinch clamps (friction) | 84.8 | 46.4 | 1.83× ✅ | per arm 2 × M5 into heat-set inserts, 1500 N (ESTIMATE ≈ 50 % of M5 insert pull-out in PETG-CF) × 0.75 creep, μ 0.3 PETG-CF/PETG-CF (ESTIMATE); T = μ·π·F·r per arm; clamp pressure 4.0 / 5.6 MPa on a solid shaft end; demand = GIM6010-8 peak × 4.44 × 0.95 |
| yaw | tube ↔ flange, hex spigot AF 24 × 8 (form) | 36.8 | 20.9 | 1.76× ✅ | flats 43 N·m (3 mm strips at 25 MPa in-layer), spigot root 37 N·m (torsion at 12 MPa across layers); + 18 N·m friction from the 6 × M3 (800 N ESTIMATE × 0.75, μ 0.3) not counted; demand = GIM6010-8 peak × 2 × 0.95 |
| yaw | tube ↔ flange, 6 × M3 inserts in tension (bending + hanging load, 20 lb basket) | 1000 | 643.7 | 1.55× ✅ | N per screw: M = 20.7 N·m × 1.5 (rnd/basket.py worst passing shoulder-pitch torque, an upper bound for the flange) about the centre + 6.7 kg × 1.5 g; capacity = M3 insert pull-out in PETG-CF ≈ 1.0 kN (ESTIMATE, coupon) |

Shaft → link torque paths (inline; Astra #2b finding 2; hand calculations, ESTIMATE inputs as listed):

| Joint | Path | Capacity | Demand | Ratio | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| roll (inline) | motor output ↔ 7075 adapter (dowels, load sharing, + 3 × M4 friction) vs the drive limit (35.1) | 106.1 | 35.1 | 3.02× ✅ | bearing allowable 150 MPa (reverted from 240: cast A380-class σ_y ≈ 160 MPa with no bearing factor, ESTIMATE until the seller names the boss material; a steel or wrought 6061-T6 boss would justify ≈ 240). 3 × Ø4 × 4 mm on r 14.25: 2.40 kN each; dowel stiffness 41 kN/mm (Huth, Ø4 steel in 4 mm Al + 7 mm 7075); the first dowel takes k·δ before the others touch: δ 8 µm (H7/m6 spread, ISO 286) when the dowels are bonded (Loctite 638) into Ø4.1 adapter holes while seated in the motor (the adapter's hole positions drop out) → 93 N·m; dry in jig-bored holes δ ≈ 40 µm (± 0.02 true position each side, ESTIMATE) → 56 N·m (the review's ≈ 55 N·m); equal sharing 103 N·m. + 3 × M4 × 10 csk at 2.0 kN, μ 0.15, metal on metal (no creep): 13 N·m (strip of 2.65 mm effective M4 in the cast boss ≈ 3.9 kN). Dowel shear 242 N·m (ISO 8734). Criterion: stall is a fault, checked at a yield-level bearing allowable at ≥ 1.0× (as bolts ≤ proof); the 7075 adapter side is 7 mm deep. The 140 N bump puts up to 0 N·m on the roll output (0.00× this capacity): below the stall only if the actuator backdrives at its current limit (open: backdrive torque, seller / bench) |
